fi-melanotaenia-herbertaxelrodi.title: Herbert Axelrod's Rainbowfish
fi-melanotaenia-herbertaxelrodi.summary: The Lake Tebera rainbowfish, Melanotaenia herbertaxelrodi, is a rainbowfish endemic to the Lake Tebera basin in the Central Highlands of New Guinea. It inhabits clear, heavily vegetated water in the…
rows: shoal of at least 6-8, preferably more.
Omnivore. Like most of its congeners it's an unfussy, omnivorous species, and will accept most dried, frozen and live foods.
notes: This rainbowfish is ideally suited to a heavily planted setup and will show its best colours in such surroundings.
Water flow should be quite slow and this will also benefit the plants.

fi-glossolepis-incisus.title: Red Irian Rainbowfish
fi-glossolepis-incisus.summary: The red rainbowfish, Glossolepis incisus, is a rainbowfish from the Lake Sentani region of northern New Guinea, Indonesia. Also known as the salmon-red or New Guinea rainbowfish, it is usually found…
rows: shoal of at least 6-8 fish, preferably more.
Unfussy and will accept most dried, frozen and live foods.
Indonesia , specifically the Lake Sentani region of Northern New Guinea .
notes: This species, like most rainbows, looks most at home in a planted aquarium.
Provide areas of dense vegetation, along with some open areas for swimming.
